name: Website Audit Services
description: Get a free professional audit of your website. We evaluate performance, SEO, accessibility, security, user experience, and code quality, then provide actionable recommendations to improve your website.

performance.name: Performance Audit
performance.description: Analyze your website's loading speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.

seo.name: SEO Audit
seo.description: Review your website's search engine optimization, including metadata, structured data, indexing, keyword optimization, and technical SEO issues.

accessibility.name: Accessibility Audit
accessibility.description: Evaluate your website against accessibility best practices and WCAG guidelines to ensure it is usable by everyone.

security.name: Security Audit
security.description: Identify common security vulnerabilities, configuration issues, and potential risks that could affect your website or users.

ux.name: UX & Design Audit
ux.description: Assess your website's user experience, navigation, responsiveness, and design consistency to improve usability and conversions.

technical.name: Technical Website Audit
technical.description: Comprehensive review of your website's code quality, architecture, best practices, maintainability, and overall technical health.
